## 3. Detailed Service Offerings

### A. Web Development & Custom Software Engineering
- **Custom Web Platforms**: Responsive, ultra-fast web architectures built on modern stacks (PHP, Node.js, Python, modern UI systems).
- **Web Applications & SaaS**: Scalable cloud architectures, bespoke dashboards, authentication systems, payment gateway integration (Razorpay, Stripe).
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: High-conversion storefronts, inventory management, seamless checkout flows.
- **API Design & Integration**: RESTful and GraphQL APIs, third-party CRM, ERP, and automation webhooks.

### B. Copyright & Digital Rights Protection
- **Content Monitoring**: 24/7 scanning of video platforms, streaming hubs, and social networks for unauthorized usage of creator or brand assets.
- **Enforcement & DMCA Takedowns**: Swift legally compliant takedown notices, counter-notice defense, and anti-piracy deterrence.
- **Asset Monetization & Claiming**: Enforcing rights holder claims on YouTube Content ID, Meta Rights Manager, and music distribution networks.

### C. Social Media Management & Brand Distribution
- **Strategy & Creative Direction**: Tone-of-voice definition, audience profiling, visual moodboards, and narrative planning.
- **Content Production**: High-retention short-form video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok), carousel design, infographics, and copywriting.
- **Account Operations**: End-to-end publishing, scheduling, hashtag research, community management, and comment moderation.

### D. Brand Identity & Creative Systems
- **Visual Identity**: Primary and secondary logos, brand marks, typographic hierarchies, color palettes, and brand guidelines.
- **Collateral & Packaging**: Digital and physical marketing collateral, stationery, packaging design, and UI kits.

### E. Digital Marketing & Performance Growth
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO, semantic schema modeling, on-page optimization, content cluster strategy, and authoritative backlink building.
- **Paid Advertising**: Meta Ads, Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), and YouTube ad funnels with strict CAC/ROAS targets.
- **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Heatmap analysis, A/B testing, user journey audits, and funnel friction removal.

---

## 4. Machine-Readable Interfaces & Specifications

- **Content Signals**: `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no` declared in `robots.txt` and HTTP headers. Content may be searched, indexed, and cited by agents, but bulk scraping for foundation model training without agreement is prohibited.
- **LLM Summary**: https://hypecrews.com/llms.txt
- **LLM Full Briefing**: https://hypecrews.com/llms-full.txt
- **SEP-1649 MCP Server Card**: https://hypecrews.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- **Markdown Negotiation**: Requesting `Accept: text/markdown` or querying `?format=md` returns a clean markdown representation of core pages.
- **WebMCP Browser Tools**: Embedded browser tools for agent interaction: `submitContactInquiry`, `trackOrder`, `subscribeNewsletter`.
- **Structured Data**: Rich JSON-LD `@graph` including `Organization`, `LocalBusiness`, `ProfessionalService`, `WebSite`, `WebPage`, `Service`, and `FAQPage`.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What services does Hypecrews provide?
Hypecrews offers end-to-end digital solutions spanning custom web application development, copyright and digital rights protection, social media management, brand identity design, and performance marketing.

### Where is Hypecrews located?
Hypecrews is headquartered in Golaghat, Assam 785621, India, and serves clients throughout India and internationally.

### How do I contact the Hypecrews team?
You can call [+91 361 324 3276](tel:+913613243276), email [info@hypecrews.com](mailto:info@hypecrews.com), or submit an inquiry at https://hypecrews.com/contact.php.

### Can an automated agent track order status?
Yes. Agents can use the `track_order` tool defined in the MCP server card (`/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`) or navigate to https://hypecrews.com/track_orders.php.

### How can a new client start a project?
Visit https://hypecrews.com/contact.php to fill out the project inquiry form, or email project briefs directly to [info@hypecrews.com](mailto:info@hypecrews.com).
